# orbivisor_backup_job (Resource)

A scheduled backup job.

Manifest kind `BackupJob`: the attributes are the manifest spec's fields in the server's JSON shape. Attributes left out keep the server's value; removing one sets the server default.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name (unique per kind; DNS label). Changing it replaces the object.
- `schedule` (Dynamic) Schedule.
- `vms` (Dynamic) VM selector.

### Optional

- `copy_to` (Dynamic)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `full_every` (Number)
- `keep` (Dynamic) Retention.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels. Terraform owns the object's labels: labels set elsewhere are removed on the next apply (server labels `orbivisor.io/…` stay).
- `pool` (String) Backup pool name.
- `replicate` (Dynamic)
- `store` (String) Backup store name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The manifest key: the name (folders `tree:/path`, grants the grant's content).
